note: Public offset alerts shown on the website. Newest first within each month. Summaries are Capital's own words; every item must link to its original source. Internal scores, suggested services and verdicts from the Offset Opportunity Monitor never go here.

items.title: Canada takes next step with Saab on GlobalEye early-warning aircraft
items.summary: Canada is moving ahead with Saab, its preferred supplier, towards a contract for six GlobalEye airborne early warning and control aircraft. Defence purchases of this size normally carry obligations under Canada's Industrial and Technological Benefits (ITB) policy.

items.title: US approves possible sale of 21 Black Hawk helicopters to Norway
items.summary: The US has notified a possible sale of 21 UH-60M Black Hawk helicopters to Norway, valued at about US$2.3 billion. Norway's industrial cooperation rules normally apply to foreign defence purchases of this size.

items.title: Boeing signs Apache offset agreements with Polish industry
items.summary: Boeing has signed offset agreements with the Polish companies WZL-1 and WCBKT covering training and sustainment for Poland's AH-64E Apache fleet.

items.title: US approves possible APKWS II laser-guided rocket sale to Saudi Arabia
items.summary: A possible sale of APKWS II laser guidance kits to Saudi Arabia, valued at about US$1.96 billion, has been notified. Saudi Arabia's industrial participation programme, run by GAMI, aims to localise a growing share of defence spending.

items.title: US approves possible sale of 155mm artillery shells to Norway
items.summary: A possible sale of 155mm M795 high-explosive shells to Norway, valued at about US$270 million, has been notified.

items.title: TKMS chosen as preferred bidder for Canada's new submarines
items.summary: Canada has selected Germany's TKMS as preferred bidder for up to 12 Type 212CD submarines under the Canadian Patrol Submarine Project. Contract negotiations, including industrial benefits for Canada, now follow.

items.title: Swiss F-35A offset programme expected to exceed its targets
items.summary: The Swiss government reports further offset projects placed with Swiss industry under the F-35A purchase, and expects the agreed offset targets to be clearly exceeded.

items.title: Canada and Australia partner on Arctic over-the-horizon radar
items.summary: Canada has agreed a partnership with Australia to deliver the Arctic Over-the-Horizon Radar, part of Canada's plan to modernise NORAD.

items.title: Swiss Armaments Programme 2026 includes more IRIS-T SLM air defence
items.summary: The Federal Council's Armaments Programme 2026 asks Parliament to fund additional IRIS-T SLM ground-based air defence systems. Swiss offset rules apply to defence purchases from foreign suppliers.
